conviction_note: The full-year forecast was already raised on 2026-09-14 (OP 460->480m, net 100->180m), so the H1 numbers are largely pre-released. The stock then moved on something else: two limit-up days on a data-sourcing deal with X Corp, and on 10/5 roughly 45% of the share count traded. Findings net to 0.0 (small pre-released positive, a small carve-out tail, and a crowded post-hype long that LESSONS rule 2 and open question 4 told me to shrink). The scaled number is p_up 48 on a 6.0% move, so -0.24. The two numbers are both near zero and agree.
bar: No H1 forecast is published (kabutan 半期予想 '－', https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=3967). The only company bar is the FY forecast revised 2026-09-14: sales 8,500m, OP 480m, ordinary 390m, net 180m (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260914/140120260909533830.pdf). No 四季報/IFIS figure was reachable, so the bar is effectively that revision plus last year's H1 OP of 92m. print_vs_bar is a soft guess on H1 OP against the trajectory the revision implies, and every size is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0%, with no disclosed position at or above 0.5% as of 2026-09-29 (baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 3967 is a 制度信用 buy-only name with no margin shorting or 貸借 (kabutan, https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=3967), so there is no short-squeeze fuel. Margin long was about 185k shares (~3% of shares) on 2026-07-17 (https://irbank.net/3967/margin); the post-10/1 figure is behind a paywall, so margin_ratio is null. Tape: 20d +25.75%, 5d -10.04%, 20d realised vol 105%. Two limit-ups on 10/1-10/2, then 2.78m shares traded on 10/5 against 6.22m issued. There is no skew in this market. priced_lean -1.29 comes entirely from the run-up.

findings.finding: The FY2/27 forecast was raised 14 days after H1 ended (OP 460->480m, ordinary 370->390m, net 100->180m). The company says sales and OP are running above internal plan in Digital Security and Physical Security (マイガードプロ). That points to H1 OP well above last year's 92m (Q1 alone 65m vs 44m), but the market has already seen it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 9/14 upward revision itself closed +3.63% on 87.9k shares. Recent prints were small and mixed: Q1 2026-07-14 -0.34% then -0.17%, FY 2026-04-14/15 -5.8% the day after, H1 2025-10-14 -2.22% (Yahoo daily bars).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The revision was filed a month ago and the stock rose 3.6% on it. What is left is the size of the H1 OP figure and its Q2 mix, given that the company still says it is 'conservative' on carve-out timing. Toward zero, per the pre-release rule.
findings.independence: The Q1 短信 shows Q1 OP of 65m vs 44m a year earlier (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260714593007.pdf). It is a different document but the same trend the revision already summarises.

findings.finding: Positioning: since its last results the stock has traded as a theme name. Two limit-ups (10/1 +17.5%, 10/2 +14.9%) on an X Corp partnership that only shortens the SNS-data sourcing route, then 2.78m shares on 10/5 (~45% of shares outstanding) and swings of -11.3%/+7.6%/-8.5%/+6.3%. Holders bought in after the 9/14 revision, so a print whose numbers are pre-released has to deliver something new to hold them.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior instance of a print after a theme spike in this name's baseline. In the US run a five-day run-in sized as a negative was wrong once (+8.15%, LESSONS open question 4). Here the 5d run-up is already -10%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the 5d -10% shows the post-spike holders already selling. If the overhang were fully cleared, volume would be back near the pre-spike 5-20k shares a day; it is still 78k by 10:05 on the print day. Built on inference with no current margin balance, so it is kept small.
findings.independence: The volume and price path comes from a different source, the Yahoo daily bars (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/3967.T?range=2y&interval=1d). The buy-only margin status is from https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=3967.

findings.finding: Carve-out and capital policy tail. The sale of the remaining two old-DX subsidiaries (GloLing, プレイネクストラボ) is targeted within FY2/27 and is expected to book a gain larger than the 119m JAPANDX loss. If the sale is announced with the results, it moves the company toward the promised net-cash turn. A buyback is unlikely at this print: the 6/25 policy says FY2/27 returns go through 優待 because of 財源規制.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 6/25 capital-policy release (net cash, about 500m in returns over 3 years, no new shares) closed +1.11% then +2.37% on very thin volume. Cancelling the 7th warrant series (8/20) produced no visible move.
findings.why_not_priced: Whether and when the sale lands is unknown. No TDnet notice on GloLing or PlayNext since 6/25 (kabutan disclosure list checked through 10/14). If the market expected an announcement at this print, the stock would not be trading on the X theme alone. The probability of it landing with H1 is low, so the size is small.
findings.independence: The 6/25 capital-policy deck (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260625/140120260623577305.pdf) states the same carve-out plan and the 財源規制 limit on a buyback this year. It comes from the same issuer.

outside_window.finding: The net-cash turn by end-FY2/27 and a later buyback or cancellation, which the 6/25 policy defers past this year because of 財源規制.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: already done 9/14, another unlikely. Returns: a buyback is unlikely given 財源規制 for FY2/27, 優待 already expanded 7/28 and 8/10, and the carve-out sale is a small-probability tail. New-year guide: not applicable (H1). Quarter: Q1 OP 65m was 13.5% of FY plan vs 10.2% (44/431) last year, and last year's H1 OP was 21% of the FY figure. The plan is Q4-heavy, so H1 progress looks ahead of its own history, and the 9/14 revision already says so.

rejected_candidates.candidate: The X Corp partnership as a revenue driver for the Webリスクモニタリング service
rejected_candidates.detail: Its price effect is already folded into the positioning finding. The release describes a change in data-sourcing route, not a revenue figure.

rejected_candidates.candidate: 47m investment-securities sale gain and 12m warrant-cancellation gain booked in Q2
rejected_candidates.detail: These items are already inside the 9/14 net-profit revision (100->180m), so they are part of finding 1.

baseline_tension: The findings net to zero, against a run-up lean of -1.29. The strongest positive the release could carry is H1 OP well above the prior year plus a carve-out sale announcement. I looked for both: the OP is pre-signalled by the 9/14 revision, and there is no sale notice yet. A buyback was checked and is constrained this year. The one negative rests on a theme crowd, not on fundamentals, and the 5d -10% shows part of that crowd has already left.
lessons_applied: Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives; write the strongest positive): the positioning negative shrank from -1.0 to -0.7 and p_up moved from 46 to 48. The negative rests on a run-up theme, not on a document, and open question 4 records a run-in short that was wrong.
Open question 3 (a prior 業績予想の修正 kills the event): the pre-released guidance finding moved from +0.5 to +0.4.
Rule 1 (visible 月次 miss) does not apply: there are no 月次 and no miss.
